G01 compares greedy online (learned) with a label-free fixed agreement threshold and a recalibrated threshold at matched budgets, with no information advantage for the baselines. Greedy minus fixed is -23.2 pp at 5% and -8.8 pp at 10%, and about 0 at 25% and 50%. The difference favors the fixed rule, so claim 2 is not_supported. For claim 3, only E01 reports embedding AUC and neighbor ratio. Every later entry uses the same model, task and proxy and reports neither, so the kill condition is unmet and the claim is open. The label confound is controlled, so W2 is false. The ledger does not hold claim 3 as supported, so W3 is false.

G01 compares the learned greedy allocator with label-free fixed and recal thresholds at the same call budget. Neither baseline has free labels. The learned arm is below the fixed threshold at 5% (-23.2 pp) and 10% (-8.8 pp) and ties at 25% and 50%. So claim 2 is not_supported, and the confound is controlled. Claim 3: only E01 reports embedding AUC gain (about 0) and neighbor ratio (about 1.0). No non-E01 entry on a different model, task or proxy reports those statistics, so the kill condition isn't met. No entry shows support either, so claim 3 is open. The ledger doesn't call claim 3 supported.
